description: This is a shell script that defines tests for a JSON writer utility called 'json-writer'. It includes multiple test cases covering JSON object and array generation, escaping, nesting, and formatting options, primarily for testing the behavior of the json-writer program.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and records the result.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs the test tool 'json-writer' with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Finalizes and reports the test suite execution.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisite tools or conditions before running tests, e.g., Perl JSON module.
